USER_STORIES Amendment 18 (2026-08-11, client-directed) — public widgets widened and protected. Binding prototype **v1.10** (`prototypes/pipeline-v1.1/index.html`, public agenda → `Get embed code`): reproduce the embed dialog one-to-one — four-format segment (Agenda | Sessions | Speakers | Call for speakers), track select, cards/list layout on Speakers, snippet URL carrying `track`/`layout` params, per-format live preview, inapplicable controls disabled never hidden.

**Build scope (on merged MRQ-22's `src/routes/embed.route.tsx` + `src/ui/embeds/`):**
1. **AC-273** — new `sessions` embed kind: flat published-session list (title, track, time), filterable by track/status like the agenda kind; selectable in the dialog; same KV cache/purge path.
2. **AC-274** — `layout=cards|list` on the `speakers` kind, chosen in the dialog, carried in the snippet URL; both responsive per AC-90.
3. **AC-217 + AC-218** (US-16, promoted to live in-scope) — new `cfp` embed kind: renders form deadline, formats, and a link to the public form; reflects close date automatically including flipping to the closed state with no republish. Track/layout controls disable for this kind.
4. Tests named with AC prefixes so `trace:ac` covers AC-217, AC-218, AC-273, AC-274 (all `auto`).

**Mechanical contract folds (this ticket, same PR):**
- `SPEC.md` **Amendment 18**: §5.12 embed dialog gains the four formats + layout/track params; `embeds.kind` enum widens to `agenda|sessions|speakers|cfp`; embeds stay anonymous-only per §5.12's iframe rule; note AC-87–90 are protected (no-cut) now MRQ-22 is merged.
- `EVALUATION.md`: four `auto` rows (AC-217, AC-218 under US-16; AC-273, AC-274 under US-58); header live in-scope and `auto` counts +4; §6 risk row 2 (Q2 embeddable gallery) closes as **resolved — built and protected**; amendment note appended.
- `BUILDPLAN.md` next free amendment number: one milestone (~5h) recording this scope, dep M-21/MRQ-22.
- **Do not touch AC-270–AC-272** — reserved for the drafted submitter/speaker split. Next mint after this ticket: AC-275.

Prototype and USER_STORIES are already updated by the gap-investigation surface (surface:177) — do not re-edit them; treat both as read-only contract inputs.
